## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The criterion hint should be fixed because following it produces criteria that the supported `require_shall=True` mode rejects. This review read both changed files, the validator, configuration example, and existing tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request rephrases the criterion guidance, spells out the bullet prefix, and adds `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Account for require_shall in the criterion hint — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion such as `- Save the result` follows the new hint but is rejected. The hint says “without the word shall,” while the validator at lines 7–8 requires `" shall "`; the existing `test_plain_bullet_under_shall_option` confirms this behavior. — Users following the guidance cannot produce a valid criterion when the shall requirement is enabled. — Fix: Qualify the guidance by validator mode so it permits the required wording when `require_shall=True`.
